title: Petition of Dover Water Company pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14 for approval and authorization by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy (1) of a $250,000 long-term loan from U.S. Trust Company; (2) to apply the net proceeds from such issuances to additions, extensions and betterments to its utility plant and for repayment of outstanding short-term indebtedness; and (3) for such other actions as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
